asset_set: Questionnaire Q19 option 2 — Studying virus mutations

questionnaire.question_text: Which repair work would you prefer?

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: calm curious science energy — symbolic and gentle, never clinical distress or outbreak panic
forbidden: sick or distressed figures, hospital beds, or syringes
anatomically accurate pathogens or spike-protein shapes

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, small calm smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — male presentation, light-medium warm skin, combed side part distinguishes from other slots

pose.stance: full body, standing at a clean lab bench, leaning gently toward a microscope
pose.action: adjusting the microscope focus knob with one hand while gently holding a petri dish beneath the lens with the other
pose.facing: 3/4 down toward the microscope, calm curious gaze

top.detail: violet cuff pinstripe, worn open over a plain tee

subject.scene_narrative: A calm young man stands at a clean lab bench, adjusting a microscope focus knob while gently holding a petri dish with soft, rounded lavender cell-blob shapes beneath the lens — full-body scientific curiosity captured in the same gentle maker language as the approved Q1 references. The scene reads as calm curious science, entirely symbolic, with no medical distress, illness, or crisis imagery.
subject.hero_prop: matte-metal microscope with a single eyepiece and focus knob
supporting_props: clear petri dish holding two soft rounded lavender cell-blob shapes with simple dot details
subject.environment: thin clean lab-bench line, faint grey decorative circles behind figure — no hazard signage or crowd
subject.sensitive_handling: Depict virus and cell study only as soft, abstract, rounded lavender blob shapes on a petri dish and microscope, held by a calm, minimally-featured full-body figure. Never show anatomically accurate pathogens, spike proteins, sick patients, needles, biohazard symbols, hazmat suits, or outbreak/pandemic imagery. Face must stay minimal and calm. Tone must read as gentle scientific curiosity, not crisis.

composition.layout: figure left-of-center leaning toward microscope right, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + microscope readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter I, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs, biohazard symbol, syringe, sick patient, hospital bed, hazmat suit, virus spike imagery, outbreak map, pandemic crisis, blood, illness distress

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal calm dot-eye face. Young slim man, light-medium warm skin, short combed side part, standing 3/4 leaning toward a matte-metal microscope at a clean lab bench. He wears a cream #F4F2EC long lab coat with a violet #4B2C7F cuff pinstripe over a plain tee, charcoal tailored trousers, and simple flats, with violet nitrile glove cuffs. He turns the microscope focus knob with one hand while gently holding a clear petri dish containing two soft, rounded, friendly lavender cell-blob shapes with simple dot details beneath the lens with the other — purely abstract, never anatomically graphic. Thin clean lab-bench line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame. Full head-to-feet visible. Calm curious scientific wonder, entirely symbolic — no biohazard, illness, or outbreak imagery. Sensitive topic handled with gentle symbolism only.
